name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Taskmaster Scrange is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the Searing Gorge.

If you are interested in this position, venture out into the Searing Gorge and slaughter every Dark Iron Taskmaster and Dark Iron Slaver that you see.

Return to Taskmaster Scrange when your clothes are bloody enough.

You'll know when they're bloody enough so don't ask.
narrative.objectives: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.
narrative.offerRewardText: 15.9 pounds! That may be a new record for blood and gut weight on apparel! Congratulations, Champion!
narrative.requestItemsText: We're gonna need to weigh you with and without clothes to be sure.
